# EclipseTone Productions

> Music production studio in Montréal, Québec, for independent artists. A song starts from the artist's voice memo, lyrics or demo: real musicians build the music, the artist records their vocals (in our Montréal studio, or at a studio near them with our guide), and we mix and master. The same team also makes music videos, CDs and USB-C cards, websites and social media, and does sound for film, TV, ads and games: original music, sound design, film mixing and voice-over recording, and Dolby Atmos mixing for music and film (with a partner Atmos studio). We don't use AI to generate music or vocals.

- Business: Smail Laouchedi, operating as EclipseTone Productions, Montréal, QC, Canada. Email laouchedismail@gmail.com.
- Languages: English and French.
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone +1 438 466 8971. Start a project: https://eclipsetone.com/#start
- Prices are in Canadian dollars. Clients in Canada pay GST and QST on top; clients outside Canada don't.
- Payment: nothing to start. Once the client approves the price, half to start and half once the client approves the music, before the vocal session. Final files are sent once everything is paid. Cancelling: the client pays for work done and non-recoverable costs, and gets the rest back within 15 days (see the Terms).
- Ownership: once the project is paid in full, the client owns the final song, the instrumental made for it and their vocal recordings, in writing, and keeps 100% of their songwriting. Covers need a licence from their writers.
- Timing (estimates): first version of the music usually within 7 days of the memo; a finished song usually takes 2 to 3 weeks, depending on the recording date and changes.

## Prices

- Mixing: from $150 CAD per song
- Studio recording (2 hours in person, Montréal, with coaching, vocal production and the mix): $350 CAD
- Full Song (from a voice memo or lyrics: music by real musicians, one 2-hour vocal session in our Montréal studio, mix and master): $599 CAD
- Song + Songwriting (adds a 2-hour writing session; the artist keeps 100% of the songwriting): $997 CAD
- 3-Song EP (three Full Songs, one studio session per song): $1,597 CAD
- Song + Launch (release plan, promo assets, launch-week support): $2,000 CAD
- CDs and USB-C cards: from $249 CAD
- Artist website: from $500 CAD
- Music video and social media management: priced per project
- Dolby Atmos mixing (music and film), music for film, sound design, film mixing and recording: custom quote, fixed price before work starts

## Free tool

- [Eclipse Lyrics](https://eclipsetone.com/lyrics/): free browser tool by EclipseTone to time lyrics to a song, export subtitles (SRT, VTT, LRC) for YouTube, CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci and Final Cut, and render lyric videos (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9, up to 4K) or a lyrics-only transparent / green-screen layer. No account; audio stays on the device. English, French and Kabyle.
